text: Evening. I'm looking after my granddaughter Rosie tonight, she's 5 months old, and she keeps tugging at her left ear. She has been at it on and off since about tea time. Her mum is away until tomorrow, so I thought I'd better ask rather than sit here wondering. She's had her bottles as normal, finished the last one no bother, so she's eating fine. It may be nothing at all and I'm being a silly old man, but I don't remember my own kids doing it and I wasn't sure whether it means something with the ear.
